Premier League · Gameweeks 12 and 13Matchup Boards

Premier League matchup boards, gameweeks 12 and 13: the model's expected goals and result chances for 11 matches, each regular's chance to score, his shots, who is out, and what each defence allows. A preview: model numbers only.

Slate NFO·CHE LEE·COV MUN·BRE IPS·AVL EVE·LIV BHA·NEW CRY·HUL FUL·BOU SUN·TOT ARS·MCI COV·IPS
NFLCFBNBASoccer
Premier LeagueBundesligaLa LigaSerie AMLS
How to read the board?
Score
Each side's expected goals, home side first, and under it the chance of a home win, a draw and an away win. The posted line beside the kickoff time is the sportsbook line ESPN shows, named there; it is not FanDuel's.
Bar and number
A player's chance to score if he starts, with the bar scaled to the match's likeliest scorer. The tag after it is his place among this round's regular starters at his position.
Position
Where he usually lines up, read from how ESPN drew his side in his last ten starts: ST striker, LW RW wings, CAM attacking mid, CM center mid, CDM defensive mid, LM RM wide mids, LB RB full backs, LWB RWB wing-backs, CB center back, GK. Once the elevens are in, it is where he lines up in this match. A player with no start this season keeps the fantasy list's group: DEF, MID or FWD.
Started N of last 5
The model does not pick line-ups. Players who started three or more of the club's last five matches are listed first; the rest sit under a line. When the confirmed elevens are in, about an hour before kickoff, each player is marked in the eleven or on the bench.
Chips
Tap a player. Each chip is a projection; its color is how much the opponent allows - goals for scoring and assists, shots for shots - #1 (green) allows the most and #20 (red) the least.
Out and doubts
From the official Fantasy Premier League list. A player listed out or suspended has no numbers; a doubt keeps his, with his chance of playing.
Premier League preview. Model numbers only: no FanDuel prices yet, so no edges or betslip buttons. Player numbers assume he starts. Nothing here is a pick: every match is locked at kickoff and graded against the result first.

A miss score is the squared gap between the chance given and what happened, so 0 is perfect. Players are graded only when they started.
